taskContracts.objective: Define P68 self-update contracts only; no self-update apply behavior.

inputs.narrowScope: Define P68 self-update contracts only; no self-update apply behavior.
safetyRules: Do not enable self-update apply, project mutation, provider dispatch, tool execution, worker execution, automatic source apply, DB writes, deploy, release, external network calls, or provider spend.
P68 starts with NEXUS OS self-update planning only; project source files remain forbidden unless a later explicit phase allows them.
Self-update previews must be reviewable, scoped, evidence-linked, approval-aware, rollback-aware, and non-executing.
Primary UX must not expose raw JSON, raw logs, raw private project IDs, fake runnable apply actions, internal phase labels outside OS Roadmap, or DemoApp outside demo mode.

reuseCheck.rule: Reuse existing result, redaction, report, mode guard, phase status, Command Center, and controlled implementation patterns; do not duplicate helpers.

uxUpdate.scope: No Command Center page behavior changes in this subphase unless explicitly listed.
uxUpdate.required: UX must show self-update intent, current state, allowed files, forbidden files, preview state, blockers, approval state, owner capability, evidence/activity location, rollback posture, and next action.

dataShapes: intentId, scope, targetKind, allowedFiles, forbiddenFiles, previewState, approvalRequired, approvalState, rollbackPlan, selfUpdateAllowed, projectMutationAllowed, executionAllowed, disabledReason, blockers, evidenceRefs, activityRefs, nextAction

inputs.commandCenterUxRequirements: Command Center must show self-update intent, current state, disabled apply state, allowed files, forbidden files, preview state, blockers, approval state, owner capability, evidence/activity location, rollback posture, and next action without raw JSON, raw logs, raw private IDs, fake runnable apply actions, internal phase labels, or DemoApp leakage.

testsCheckers: Add or keep P68-specific checker coverage for this subphase.
Keep backend/kernel behavior covered by checker scripts.
